method: Own stdlib JSON reduction; 1461 unique exact full rows and384 unique parsed canonical bodies. All source IDs/hash values retain reversible alias map. Reduction is not semantic completion. No source checker/SQL/TS/C#/fixture executed.
semantic_notes: SUGGESTED→IGNORED writes6 rows/updates, no native effects; fresh conditional Core permission sequence2 and five masks do not prove actualgrant.

First PR40EA uses two20EA pegs. Native REJECTED with provesNoEffect and precise request closes original key and releases full ownportion. Fresh explicit preview+start may create second nativekey using businessversion4 while retained Firm authorityversion2; separate Ignore branch is alternative.

PR NOT_OBSERVED contains convertRequestId but no requestDigest/sourceAllocationRef in native arm. Local enrichment binds original key; previous MAY_HAVE_BEEN_SENT becomes UNKNOWN and never authorizes new key or releases/winner/stock.
CP19 WMS three aggregate worlds public65/machine68 semantic deltas read against current first201; accepted+unknown PENDING, accepted+complete no-effect PARTIAL, allaccepted SUCCEEDED.
WO continuous ordinals0–3, root firstclaim/original request and all16 issuer contexts read; null-preparation4 captures then11 bound-preparation captures preserve external issuer boundaries.

Cross-epoch all9 worlds cutover23/takeover24, initial same-key query, 4 frozen-read consumptions and 5 absence branches, first same-body send eligibility and MAY_HAVE_BEEN_SENT no-send case read with exact repeated structures/deltas.
semantic_boundary: Structured semantic reading of every business case, request/native result/parameter/write/replay branch, all 47 table column/value classes and 384 distinct embedded JSON bodies. Repeated complete row objects and identical JSON subtrees reused by exact equality. Individual opaque UUID/hash/rowversion character strings are not claimed as prose reading; their identity and equality are retained and checked. No SQL, source checker, project build, native call or runtime validation executed.

physical_reading.opaque_literal_boundary: Opaque UUID/hash/rowversion literals were preserved and compared, not interpreted as separate business requirements.

static_verification.comparison_boundary: Compare complete table+row values as unordered multisets; optional row wrapper key separately validated against full PK, not silently omitted.
not_proven: SQL execution and physical DDL acceptance

integration_findings.claim: 18 retained PlanningFactHead row wrappers name IAM/<old uuid> while their actual row.ResourceKey is the current hashed resource key. The full actual table+row transition comparison has zero differences; this is stale wrapper metadata, not proof of a runtime defect.
integration_findings.impact: Do not use wrapper.key as authoritative row identity when replaying/importing these example rowsets before alignment.
integration_findings.exit_condition: Owner aligns wrappers with actual complete primary-key fields or documents an explicit separate wrapper-key meaning, then reruns static fixture identity comparison.

integration_findings.claim: The CP19 WO step1 CreatePreparation response uses executionRequestKey MAKE-CONVERT-20261002-001 while frozen request uses CP18-MAKE-579b4a48-c253-5aa9-834d-1847c3733973. Current native kernel step1 explicitly requires equality among prior source item, frozen current request and result executionKey; direct use of this example does not satisfy that textual predicate.
